class.name: BehaviorTreeWait
class.brief_description: Waits for a duration without blocking the main thread.
class.description: Returns [constant BehaviorTreeTask.RUNNING] until cumulative tick time reaches [member duration], then returns [constant BehaviorTreeTask.SUCCESS]. Elapsed time is tracked per runner and per position in the tree, so a single resource can safely be reused. Resetting the runner discards elapsed time.

members.member: Duration to wait in seconds. Must be nonnegative.
